items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: Jerry was interviewed via Zoom on August 18, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Saxophonist and jazz educator Jerry Coker is a pioneer in the field of jazz education. After gigs with Woody Herman and Stan Kenton, Jerry turned his attention to the need for a resource for aspiring jazz improvisers. His books span decades and topics, including Improvising Jazz (1964) and the Jazz Age in Jerry was interviewed via Zoom on August 18, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. Jerry’s son, Curt Coker, assisted in the interview.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Jerry Coker with me today for the Fillius Jazz Archive. Welcome, sir.
